# GitHub Labels Configuration
# Use this reference to create custom labels in your repository
# Go to: https://github.com/Shabangujj/Phola_park_app/labels

## Priority Labels
# - **Priority: Critical** (Color: #FF0000) - Must be fixed immediately
# - **Priority: High** (Color: #FF6600) - Should be fixed soon
# - **Priority: Medium** (Color: #FFCC00) - Can be scheduled
# - **Priority: Low** (Color: #99CCFF) - Nice to have

## Type Labels
# - **type: bug** (Color: #D73A49) - Something isn't working
# - **type: feature** (Color: #0366D6) - New feature request
# - **type: enhancement** (Color: #A2EEEF) - Improvement to existing feature
# - **type: documentation** (Color: #0075CA) - Documentation improvements
# - **type: chore** (Color: #CCCCCC) - Maintenance tasks
# - **type: refactor** (Color: #7B3FF2) - Code refactoring

## Status Labels
# - **status: backlog** (Color: #FBCA04) - Not yet started
# - **status: in-progress** (Color: #FFC900) - Currently being worked on
# - **status: in-review** (Color: #0366D6) - Waiting for review
# - **status: blocked** (Color: #D73A49) - Cannot proceed
# - **status: on-hold** (Color: #999999) - Paused temporarily
# - **status: done** (Color: #28A745) - Completed

## Area Labels
# - **area: auth** (Color: #D4C5F9) - Authentication & authorization
# - **area: api** (Color: #5DADE2) - REST API
# - **area: database** (Color: #145A32) - Database & migrations
# - **area: ui** (Color: #E8B4B8) - User interface
# - **area: notifications** (Color: #F39C12) - Notification system
# - **area: reports** (Color: #2E86C1) - Report functionality
# - **area: surveys** (Color: #1ABC9C) - Survey functionality

## Other Labels
# - **good first issue** (Color: #7057FF) - Good for first-time contributors
# - **help wanted** (Color: #33AA3F) - Additional support needed
# - **question** (Color: #D876E3) - Needs clarification
# - **duplicate** (Color: #CCCCCC) - Duplicate of another issue
# - **wontfix** (Color: #FFFFFF) - Not going to be fixed
# - **security** (Color: #D73A49) - Security-related issue
# - **performance** (Color: #FFA500) - Performance improvement

## How to Create Labels
# 1. Go to Issues → Labels
# 2. Click "New label"
# 3. Enter the label name, description, and color
# 4. Click "Create label"

## Recommended Label Setup Order
1. Priority: Critical, High, Medium, Low
2. Type: bug, feature, enhancement, documentation, chore, refactor
3. Status: backlog, in-progress, in-review, blocked, on-hold, done
4. Area: auth, api, database, ui, notifications, reports, surveys
5. Other: good first issue, help wanted, question, duplicate, wontfix, security, performance
